Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The code chart is read as printed; restriction J is listed there as specific limitations, while the first chapter calls the driver education restriction J, so no single meaning beyond the chart is taught here [A01] (verify IN-RESTRICT-D-JCODE).
The text after Other restrictions include on the code page did not come through in the extracted text, so no further restrictions are claimed from it [A01].
The motorcycle permit riding-hours sentence names one-half hour before sunrise and one-half hour after sunset without saying between; it is reported as a daylight window bounded by those times and flagged [A02] (verify IN-RESTRICT-D-MCHOURS).
The autocycle rule on more than one autocycle in a single lane is reported as printed, without inferring a side-by-side meaning [A03].
Motorcycle and for-hire items are outside the first-time car license path and are kept for completeness with scope notes in C2.
